boiling_point_c.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ethanol_(data_page) (760 mm Hg at 78.4 °C); NIST WebBook https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C64175&Mask=4 lists Tboil 351.5 ± 0.2 K (fetched 2026-11-28)

melting_point_c.source: NIST WebBook https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C64175&Mask=4 (Tfus 159 ± 2 K = -114.15 °C, average of 11 values); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ethanol_(data_page) lists -114.3 °C (fetched 2026-11-28)

solubility_in_water.source: miscible with water; commonly quoted textbook value; check a primary source before citing

safety.summary: Low hazard classroom liquid. Keep away from heat sources in real use.
safety.storage: Tightly closed container away from heat.
safety.source: General laboratory safety guidance written for this project; check the supplier's safety data sheet before real use.

display.summary: A common solvent used for mixing and evaporation examples.

enthalpy_fusion_j_per_g.source: NIST WebBook https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C64175&Mask=4 (ΔfusH 4.64 kJ/mol, Domalski and Hearing 1996, evaluated) ÷ 46.069 g/mol (fetched 2026-11-28)
enthalpy_fusion_j_per_g.note: Published values range from 4.626 to 5.021 kJ/mol.

enthalpy_vaporization_j_per_g.source: NIST WebBook https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C64175&Mask=4 (ΔvapH 38.56 kJ/mol at 351.5 K, Majer and Svoboda 1985) ÷ 46.069 g/mol (fetched 2026-11-28)

specific_heat_liquid_j_per_g_k.source: NIST WebBook https://webbook.nist.gov/cgi/cbook.cgi?ID=C64175&Mask=6 (Cp,liquid 112.30 J/(mol·K) at 298.15 K, Vesely et al. 1979) ÷ 46.069 g/mol (fetched 2026-11-28)
